name: handoff
description: Attach to and checkpoint shared agent-session context, per project.

args: ok_node() { "$1" -e 'process.exit(process.versions.node.split(".")[0] >= 18 ? 0 : 1)' >/dev/null 2>&1; }; candidate=''; if command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then candidate=$(command -v node); fi; if [ -n "$candidate" ] && ok_node "$candidate"; then exec "$candidate" "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/mcp-server/index.js"; fi; for d in "$HOME/.nvm/versions/node"/*/bin "$HOME/.fnm/node-versions"/*/installation/bin "$HOME/.asdf/installs/nodejs"/*/bin /opt/homebrew/bin /usr/local/bin "$HOME/.local/bin" "$HOME/.volta/bin"; do if [ -x "$d/node" ] && ok_node "$d/node"; then exec "$d/node" "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/mcp-server/index.js"; fi; done; if [ -n "$candidate" ]; then ver=$("$candidate" --version 2>/dev/null); echo "handoff: found node ${ver:-unknown} on PATH but need >=18, and no newer node found in nvm/fnm/asdf/homebrew/volta locations" >&2; else echo 'handoff: node not found on PATH or in common install locations' >&2; fi; exit 127
